actionConfiguration.body: SELECT public.issue20_set_organization_terminology({{ JSON.stringify(appsmith.user?.email || '') }}, {{ JSON.stringify(selTerminologyConcept.selectedOptionValue || '') }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermSingular.text || '').trim()) }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermPlural.text || '').trim()) }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermShort.text || '').trim() || null) }}, {{ selTermActive.selectedOptionValue === 'true' }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermReason.text || '').trim()) }}) AS changed;

SELECT public.issue20_set_organization_terminology({{ JSON.stringify(appsmith.user?.email || '') }}, {{ JSON.stringify(selTerminologyConcept.selectedOptionValue || '') }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermSingular.text || '').trim()) }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermPlural.text || '').trim()) }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermShort.text || '').trim() || null) }}, {{ selTermActive.selectedOptionValue === 'true' }}, {{ JSON.stringify((inpTermReason.text || '').trim()) }}) AS changed;

children.text: Directory managers can configure organization-facing terminology. Labels change presentation only; they do not rename roles, grant appointments or permissions, or rewrite historical records or executed agreements.
You need Directory Manager permission to administer terminology.
Edit the labels below and review the concept, singular, plural, short label, and active state before saving.

children.onClick: {{ (async()=>{ const rows = await qSetTerminology.run(); await qTerminology.run(); showAlert(rows?.[0]?.changed ? 'Terminology updated.' : 'No terminology changes were needed.', 'success'); })() }}

children.text: Reserved concepts such as facilitator may remain inactive. Activating or renaming a concept never creates that appointment or changes authorization.
